# Create Ticket Prompt

Using the PRD, HLD, LLD, ADRs, DEVELOPMENT_PROCESS and requested scope, produce one GitHub-ready implementation ticket.

Do not implement code.

Use the project Definition of Done.

If the work is too large or crosses independently deliverable FE/BE boundaries, propose smaller tickets instead.
